mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.75% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.75%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or positive returns fail in more than 55% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with RSAFS above 450,000 million dollars, stretched valuations lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 450,000 million dollars, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 thousand persons supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% triggers monetary policy tightening expectations that increase real interest rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates supply chain disruption and economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between INDPRO and GDPC1 has a Rank IC below -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or negative returns fail in more than 55% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS above 0.5%), higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
